newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Scottish Media in 105 mln stg credit.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Scottish Media in 105 mln stg credit.

text.p: LONDON, June 10 (LPC) - Scottish Media Group Plc has signed a 105 million stg revolving credit facility with Royal Bank of Scotland, according to Gary Hughes, Scottish Media's group finance director.
The credit has been arranged to back Scottish Media's takeover of Grampian Television Plc, in which it will acquire the entire share capital for 105.4 million stg.
The five-year revolving credit carries an average margin of 27.5 bps over LIBOR which is tied to a pricing grid linked to the level of utilisation of the credit.

The facility reduces to 76 million stg after year three and to 52.5 million stg after year four. Royal Bank of Scotland may syndicate the loan to other banks at a later date depending on the level of draw-down.
Scottish Media, formerly Scottish Television, broadcasts to Glasgow, Edinburgh and central Scotland. Grampian Television is the ITV license holder for northern Scotland.
